lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately three distinct vertical columns on the visible flank area posterior to the dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs, creating a grid-like structural arrangement across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlight on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The apex of the dorsal fin exhibits a significant traumatic amputation, resulting in a jagged, irregular terminal margin and loss of the natural pointed silhouette.
